subject.why: Accurately depicts the toadstool cottage, door, window, and lantern.

category.why: Includes scattered flowers and plants instead of a clean ground strip.

clean.why: Free of text, logos, UI, and characters.

framing.why: Well-centered composition with visible margins and clear sky above.

colour.why: Saturated, bright palette with clear contrast against the sky.

detail.why: Extra scenery props like flowers and vines clutter the base.

style.why: Smooth, chunky 3D volumes and satin sheen match the reference style.

fix: Remove the flowers, vines, and extra plant props to leave only a simple, clean strip of grass at the bottom.
